translationRepairs: Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yong Guling.
Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yonggu Mausoleum.
s0038 葬永固陵 names the tomb Yonggu Mausoleum as one word; 'Yong Guling' wrongly splits 永固 and 陵, and Yonggu Mausoleum is the accurate English rendering.
Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yong Guling.
Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yonggu Mausoleum.
The literal field of s0038 has the same error for 永固陵; replacing 'Yong Guling' with Yonggu Mausoleum corrects the place name without inventing content.
Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun and the empress styled themselves Heavenly Primordial Emperor and Heavenly Primordial Empress.
Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun styled himself Heavenly Primordial Emperor and titled the empress Heavenly Primordial Empress.
s0076 pairs 自稱天元皇帝 with 號后為天元皇后: the emperor alone assumed the emperor title and then titled the empress; the original wrongly has both styling themselves.
The emperor was greatly enraged and thereupon ordered the empress to die, forcing her to take farewell.
The emperor was greatly enraged and thereupon ordered the empress to die, forcing her to commit suicide.
s0093 逼令引訣 is the classical idiom for compelling suicide after 賜后死; 'take farewell' misreads 訣 and understates the forced self-killing.
